## Security reporting

Please do not disclose vulnerabilities, exploit steps, private keys, CSIDs, API secrets, OTPs, real certificates, or production credentials in a public issue.

Use the private reporting guidance in [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) instead.

## What to include in a private report

- A summary of the issue
- Affected versions
- Reproduction steps or proof of concept
- Impact assessment
- Any suggested mitigation
